environment.description: Same application deployed in namespace 'webhooks' on the same EKS cluster. Istio sidecar injected with STRICT mTLS. An AuthorizationPolicy resource exists in the 'istio-system' namespace (root namespace) with a DENY action matching source namespace 'webhooks' for any request to destinations outside the 'webhooks' namespace. However, this policy operates at the mesh layer (L4/L7 between sidecars) and applies to east-west service mesh traffic. The pod's Envoy sidecar intercepts outbound connections and enforces the policy. A separate PeerAuthentication resource in the mesh config sets mtls mode to STRICT globally. Note: the AuthorizationPolicy uses a custom workload selector label 'mesh-egress-controlled: true' which is applied to all pods in the namespace via a mutating webhook.

config.mutating_webhook: adds mesh-egress-controlled=true to all pods in webhooks namespace
